title: First time visit to La Sagrada Familia, hopefully not the last.
text: We had an absolutely fantastic time touring La Sagrada Familia.  Paola was a very knowledgeable guide and she provided essential details of Gaudi's influences of nature that translated into the design elements of the church.  As a first time visitor there are likely things one would miss when touring on your own.  With a guide you miss a lot less which makes the visit more impactful.
